iut_type: Pre-registration consulting (Move Corporation), free derivative model addition rules under an existing Qualification
customer_question: Is Bluetooth certification required for every individual model name? For example, if model AAAAA is already registered/qualified, and we create a Japan-only derivative model BBBBB using the same QDID, is certification needed again, and can the new model name simply be added?
question_variants: Is the registration fee charged per model, or per underlying qualification?
Does adding a derivative model name to the Product List require any additional certification step?
actual_issue: The customer wanted to understand whether Bluetooth certification is a per-model-name requirement (implying repeated $11,040 fees for every derivative model) or whether it's tied to the underlying technical qualification, with model names handled separately and more cheaply.
plain_english_explanation: A Bluetooth product's 'certification' consists of two distinct parts: a paid Qualification/Listing ($11,040) tied to the underlying SoC/module, Host Stack, and profile implementation, and a Product Listing that names the specific models sold under that qualification. Once the paid Qualification is completed for a base model, any additional derivative model implementing the exact same SoC/module and Host Stack can be added to that qualification's Product List for free, at any time, with no limit on how many derivative models can be added this way -- Bluetooth SIG explicitly recognizes free derivative Product List additions as a complete and sufficient certification action for those derivative models, with no further per-model certification step required.
consultant_answer: Bluetooth certification isn't per model name -- it's tied to the underlying Qualification (the SoC/module, Host Stack, and profile implementation), which is paid once ($11,040). Any derivative model using the exact same SoC/module and Host Stack can then be added to that Qualification's Product List for free, with no limit on how many models you add this way, and no certification fee or additional step required for each one -- adding the model name to the Product List is itself the complete certification action for that derivative model.
decision_logic: Bluetooth certification cost and effort scale with the underlying technical qualification (SoC/module, Host Stack, profile implementation), not with the number of model names sold under it -- any number of derivative models sharing the exact same qualification can be added to the Product List for free as a complete certification action.
final_recommendation: When a customer plans to release multiple model variants (e.g., regional SKUs) sharing the same underlying Bluetooth implementation, clarify upfront that only the first model requires the paid Qualification, and all subsequent identical-implementation models can be added free as derivatives, to avoid the customer overestimating their total certification cost.
risk_if_done_wrong: A customer mistakenly believing every model name requires its own paid certification could either overbudget significantly or unnecessarily delay launching regional/derivative SKUs out of a misplaced cost concern.
